# Performance overview

## Performance results

The initial example benchmark shows sub-linear scaling from 2 to 6 reactions: a three-fold increase in reactions increases estimated wall time by only ~1.4-fold. In practice, this means that larger projects should benefit substantially from the pipeline's reaction-level and branch-level parallelism when sufficient compute resources are available, rather than scaling like a fully serial workflow.
